description: Respond to an inline button click (callback event from get_updates). You can update the original message text and/or show a notification popup to the user. Must be called within 30 seconds of the button press.

callback_id.description: The callback_id from the message_callback event (get_updates)

message_text.description: New text for the original message (optional, updates the message in-place)

notification.description: Short notification text shown as a popup to the user (optional)

user_id.description: The user_id of the user who clicked the button

name: answer_callback
title: Answer Callback
